dslRule:
<!id: use-linkedhashset-for-ordered-set-init>
<!description: Replace HashSet with LinkedHashSet for local variables to preserve insertion order, ensuring predictable iteration. This is a safe change for local variables where thread-safety is not a concern.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: collection, order, performance>

new java.util.HashSet<$Generics$>($args$)
:: isAssignedToLocalVariable()
=>
new java.util.LinkedHashSet<$Generics$>($args$)
;;
summary: Replaces `new HashSet(...)` with `new LinkedHashSet(...)` for local variable initializations to ensure predictable iteration order.
